eval_feedback.overall: All four assertions clearly met. Minor over-readings are not contradicted by the fixture, so none is listed as wrong: 'three independent sources' (the fixture doesn't say they are independent), 'The response reports no failed sources (no degraded_sources)' (the opencheck_owners fixture has no degraded_sources field at all, so this is inferred from its absence), and the ~33% free-float remark comes from outside knowledge.
